sources.snippet: CamemBERT is a language model based on RoBERTa, but trained specifically on French text from the OSCAR dataset, making it more effective for French language tasks. What sets CamemBERT apart is that it learned from a huge, high quality collection of French data, as opposed to mixing lots of languages. This helps it really understand French better than many multilingual models. Common ...
